what_happened.line: PACC began recruiting residents for a separate committee to renegotiate the town's Comcast cable license before it expires.
The FY27 budget approved at Town Meeting draws on retained earnings to cover cable operations, pending state requalification of those funds.
The committee corrected its draft minutes to note an investment figure was an estimate set by the town treasurer, not one the committee determined.
The committee plans to meet before the end of June to reconcile its investment/trust fund figures with the finance department's own posting.

why_it_matters: The Comcast license renegotiation will shape the terms and revenue that fund the town's cable and public-access operations for years to come.
The FY27 cable budget's use of retained earnings is not yet finalized, since the state must first requalify those funds.
The committee's own investment figures currently do not match the town's official financial report, which affects confidence in the numbers reported to the public.
